## Structured fields

Schemas for the additional fields of a subject. These fields hold rows validated against a published schema; the form shows them as a table, the API returns them as stored. The fields of each row:

### Additional fields

Any extra parameters you want to add to this subject. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `key` | Text. |
| `value` | Object. |

The schemas are published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Subject/` (see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/)); the API view with property codes is on the [Subject API page](/api/stem/subject/#json-field-schemas).
